ingredients.name: Rump or sirloin steak

ingredients.name: Thin-cut minute steak
ingredients.note: Shaved steak or shaved ribeye. Slice minute steak thinly

ingredients.name: Smoked bacon medallions
ingredients.note: Beef bacon, centre-cut bacon or Canadian bacon. 1 US slice ≈ 20 g of medallions

ingredients.name: 10% fat beef mince
ingredients.note: 90/10 ground beef or ground bison. Bison isn't sold at Aldi or Morrisons

ingredients.name: Reduced-fat pork sausages (skins off)

ingredients.name: Cooked ham slices
ingredients.note: Canadian ham or diced ham. 1 slice ≈ 19 g, 1 US package ≈ 227 g

ingredients.name: Pepperoni slices
ingredients.note: Turkey pepperoni isn't common in the UK. Regular pepperoni is much higher in fat. 1 slice ≈ 2 g

ingredients.name: Liquid egg whites (carton)
ingredients.note: Egg whites. 1 cup = 243 g. If you can't find a carton, 1 egg white ≈ 33 g

ingredients.name: Low-fat cottage cheese
ingredients.note: 2% or low-fat cottage cheese. 1 cup = 225 g

ingredients.name: Light mozzarella (grate it)

ingredients.name: Lighter mature grated cheddar

ingredients.name: Mature grated cheddar
ingredients.note: Sharp or extra sharp cheddar. 1 US bag = 226 g

ingredients.name: Lighter cheese slices
ingredients.note: American, pepper jack, provolone, gouda or Colby slices. One slice for one slice

ingredients.name: Light ranch dressing (or yogurt with dill, chives and garlic)

ingredients.name: American mustard
ingredients.note: Yellow, Dijon or honey mustard (add a little honey for honey mustard)

ingredients.name: Burger or gherkin relish

ingredients.name: Gherkins (jar)

ingredients.name: BBQ sauce

ingredients.name: Sweet chilli sauce

ingredients.name: Frank's RedHot or buffalo hot sauce
ingredients.note: Frank's RedHot or buffalo sauce. 1 cup = 240 ml

ingredients.name: Light garlic & herb sauce
ingredients.note: Low-calorie garlic parmesan wing sauce. No close UK match

ingredients.name: Fresh tomato salsa
ingredients.note: Pico de gallo. 1 fl oz ≈ 28 g

ingredients.name: Passata

ingredients.name: Creamy pasta sauce (jar, e.g. carbonara)

ingredients.name: Sweetcorn (tin, drained)

ingredients.name: Black beans (tin, drained)

ingredients.name: Red kidney beans (tin, drained)

ingredients.name: Stock cubes

ingredients.name: Brown onions

ingredients.name: Salad tomatoes

ingredients.name: White potatoes

ingredients.name: Baby potatoes
ingredients.note: Nibbles, baby gold or mini potatoes

ingredients.name: Basmati or jasmine rice (dry)
ingredients.note: Rice, weighed raw. 1 cup raw = 185 g

ingredients.name: Dried pasta (penne, fusilli or macaroni)

ingredients.note: No Yolks egg noodles. 1 US bag = 340 g

ingredients.name: White sub rolls

ingredients.name: Tortilla chips
